exposure: Reversed end-diastolic flow in umbilical artery
Absent end-diastolic flow in umbilical artery
outcome: Composite adverse neonatal outcome (intraventricular hemorrhage, periventricular leukomalacia, cerebral infarction and/or necrotizing enterocolitis)
cohort: 66 singleton pregnancies complicated by intrauterine growth restriction
finding: High amniotic fluid erythropoietin concentrations are associated with decreased umbilical artery pH and base excess and with adverse neonatal outcome in pregnancies complicated by intrauterine growth restriction before 34 gestational weeks.
